name: tx-classifier
description: Transaction-classification workflow for the casa finance specialist — a skill-only plugin that classifies bank-feed transactions, maintains the deterministic auto-tagging rulebook, and runs the parked-row operator Q&A. No server, no storage: all durable state lives in bank-feed (queue, workflow tags, notes, rule rationales). Ships bundled with the finance specialist beside bank-feed.

jobs.name: classify-transactions
jobs.title: Classify transactions
jobs.summary: Tag untagged transactions in batches, park the ones that need the operator, keep the rulebook current
